requirements.family_selection_rule: Before any new model outputs: select only a family with valid unsaturated frozen baseline exact-grid evidence, exact verified TRAIN content and latent provenance, an available deterministic generator, and matched control capacity. Nominal scalar-loss share alone cannot select a family.
requirements.independent_units: Resample/gate at canonical latent-task unit; do not count prompt variants as independent units.
requirements.latent_parameter_manifest: Each TRAIN and validation unit stores canonical latent parameter SHA256 and family-relevant structural signature.
requirements.legitimate_train_content_manifest: Every TRAIN episode stores canonical public input/output content SHA256, generator revision, source provenance, and family label before model outputs.
requirements.matched_controls: Each atomic family requires a functionally sufficient control and a single target operation with identical layout/color marginal distributions where feasible.
overlap_gates: no validation target used in training construction or selection
requirements.validation_split: Validation must be content-SHA-disjoint and latent-signature-disjoint from TRAIN; roles are frozen before inference.
